subject: Procurement follow-up: scorecard, payment route, and approver roster
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: procurement scorecard and decision path

Hi Emily / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — wanted to capture the quick post-call recap and a couple of asks so we can unblock internal approvals on your side. Attached is the procurement scorecard I promised and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP).

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Use case: ML-assisted prior authorization routing for ambulatory clinics (pilot 3 clinics).
- Timing: pilot targeted for Nov rollout, production in Q1.
- Expected spend: ~$60k/year initially.
- Primary blocker: procurement/PO path and signatory approval.

Can you confirm the following so we can propose the right commercial path?
1) Preferred payment instrument: PO (invoice) vs corporate card? Any SSO/marketplace procurement route required (AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace)?
2) Who is the budget owner and finance sponsor (name + email)?
3) Any standard vendor intake forms or security checklist we should complete before legal/finance review?

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop in Ben (billing) to outline card vs PO flows and timelines, and Marissa (commercial/legal) to flag any vendor/contract requirements. If you confirm budget owner today, we’ll generate a short SOW + purchase instructions by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: procurement-scorecard.xlsx; redwood-mutual-action-plan.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emily Soto <emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@mark.chen@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement scorecard and decision path

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers below:

1) Payment: prefer PO/invoice for pilots over $25k; card OK for small pilots or POCs < $5k. We do have an AWS Marketplace procurement path for some teams, but the pilot team is not set up there yet.
2) Budget owner: Mark Chen, Director of Clinical Programs (mark.chen@evergreenhealth.com). Finance sponsor: Lisa Park (lisa.park@evergreenhealth.com), cc’d procurement generally for intake.
3) Vendor intake: we need a standard vendor form + W-9 and SOC 2 attestation (we can accept the SOC 2 link). Also any Data Processing Addendum (DPA) or HIPAA language up front would be helpful.

Can you confirm estimated lead time for a PO route (from our PO submission to invoice paid) and what contract path you recommend (standard Redwood MSA vs marketplace)?

—Emily

Emily Soto
Program Manager, Innovation | Evergreen Health Systems
emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement scorecard and decision path

Thanks Emily — super helpful. Looping in Ben and Marissa to scope the billing and contracting options.

Ben / Marissa, summary from Emily below: prefer PO for pilots >$25k; budget owner = Mark Chen; finance sponsor = Lisa Park. Procurement requires vendor form, W-9, SOC 2, and wants DPA/HIPAA language. Can you advise:
- If they go PO route, what is a realistic timeline from PO issue to first invoice (our typical churn/ops)?
- If they want marketplace, what do we need to enable (is Evergreen already onboarded)?
- Any commercial flex for a pilot (payment terms, onboarding credit) to speed approval?

If helpful I can propose two paths in a single email: 1) PO + standard MSA + DPA; 2) Marketplace SKU + Marketplace terms. Emily — which would you prefer us to prioritize?

Best,
Jonas
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Emily Soto <emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement scorecard and decision path

Emily/Jonas — quick billing notes from ops:

- PO path: once we receive a signed PO and vendor form, typical timeline to process the first invoice is ~7–10 business days. Payment terms we usually offer: Net 30. If Evergreen needs Net 45/60 we can discuss but will require commercial approval.
- Card: immediate setup and charge; good for < $5k.
- Marketplace: we can list a pilot SKU on AWS Marketplace but Evergreen would need marketplace billing enabled; onboarding usually takes 2–3 weeks depending on their procurement team.

For the pilot I recommend the PO route (given size) — we can accelerate with a short SOW + POC addendum and a 30-day invoice. If you sign the PO quickly we can start onboarding next week.

I’ve attached a short vendor form template and W-9 stub we can prefill to speed things up.

Attachments referenced: vendor-form.pdf; W-9.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@evergreenhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement scorecard and decision path

Emily — thanks for the details. Two quick legal/commercial items:

1) Signatory path: for contracts <= $100k we can accept a Director-level signatory (Mark would be fine). For anything larger we need VP-level approval. Please confirm the internal signatory roster when you submit the PO.
2) Docs: we’ll provide a short MSA + DPA and can include HIPAA addendum language. If Evergreen requires SOC 2 Type II evidence, please send the link or point of contact and we’ll provide our audit summary.

I’ll draft the MSA + DPA and share a DocuSign envelope for a streamlined PO + MSA signing flow. Jonas — I’ll need the exact billing address and legal entity name you want on the vendor form.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
